name: labs/bsh90__smarpod-ophyd
title: SmarAct SmarPod hexapod (gh.bsh90/smarpod-ophyd SmarSignal)
intro: SmarAct SmarPod hexapod (gh.bsh90/smarpod-ophyd SmarSignal), adapted from bsh90/smarpod-ophyd. It sets `pose`; runs `move_pose` and `stop_motion`. `move_pose`: move the hexapod to a six-component pose and return the pose read after the controller reports STOPPED. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/bsh90__smarpod-ophyd --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/bsh90__smarpod-ophyd --backend fake --mcp
